clusters.headline: President Trump Indicates Potential Diplomacy With Iranian Officials
aiSummaryBullets: President Trump expressed that authorizing military strikes on Iran is highly unlikely as long as diplomatic negotiations proceed.
Secretary of State Marco Rubio described current Iranian negotiation demands as unrealistic while noting the public unpopularity of a potential war.

clusters.headline: Explosions Reported In Strait Of Hormuz Amidst Diplomatic Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and on tankers following encounters with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has officially removed the previous 2,000-kilometer range restriction on its ballistic missile program.
